paragraphs: NueGOV sells modular software for managing assets, infrastructure, inspections, work zones, and projects across government departments. The homepage states the platform is built for law enforcement, fire, OEM, DOTs, MPOs and cities and counties. Buyers take only the modules they need, with assets and inspections for public safety and infrastructure, work zones and projects for transportation.

One case study describes the Decatur Police Department, which manages uniforms, body-worn cameras, radios, and patrol vehicle equipment. That department reported a 13% reduction in asset-related expenditures in the first year. Another case study covers digitizing a form for temporary speed limit reductions at the Colorado Department of Transportation. A third case study covers a guardrail validation and assessment, with the resulting inventory held in the NueGOV platform.

quote.text: NueGOV built the product specific to our workflows and our requirements. This partnership has been beneficial.
